says: The glossary says desktop means only layer 5, Tuval, but libfabrika's desktop/ module holds the Mac app's brain service, launchd control and the menu bar's machine, so a reader looking for 0274's platform-free desktop core finds the brain's lifecycle.
proof: .glossary/TERMS.md:405 reads 'desktop | Only layer 5, Tuval: the desktop environment'; next/packages/libfabrika/src/desktop/BrainService.ts:2 reads 'Public lifecycle for a home-owned brain' and desktop/BrainControl.ts:2 'Installation and service-manager contract'; layer-rules.json names the folder next-desktop-core.
cost: Plans for the client core (P18) and the desk read the word two ways; the P18 draft had to check that desktop/ is not the core 0274 names.
